items.title: Flakestorm – Chaos engineering for AI agents (local-first, open source)
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi everyone, I’ve been working on an open-source tool called Flakestorm to test the reliability of AI agents before they hit production. Most agent testing today focuses on eval scores or happy-path prompts. In practice, agents tend to fail in more mundane ways: typos, tone shifts, long context, malformed input, or simple prompt injections — especially when running on smaller or local models.
Flakestorm applies chaos-engineering ideas to agents. Instead of testing one prompt, it takes a “golden prompt”, generates adversarial mutations (semantic variations, noise, injections, encoding edge cases), runs them against your agent, and produces a robustness score plus a detailed HTML report showing what broke. Key points:
Local-first (uses Ollama for mutation generation) Tested with Qwen / Gemma

excerpt_i18n.en:
On January 5, 2026, 01.AI officially released its "Six Major Predictions for Chinese Enterprise AI Agents in 2026" and showcased its latest exploration in enterprise multi-agent systems—"Wanzhi 2.5 Enterprise Multi-Agent." According to an IDC report, the $650 billion enterprise application software market is poised to be disrupted by AI agents. By 2031, AI agent penetration in customer service centers, sales teams, and marketing applications is expected to approach 100%. IDC also conservatively estimates that the market size for enterprise AI agent applications in China will reach over $27 billion by 2028.

While the industry is still exploring solutions for enterprise AI agent implementation, 01.AI has proposed a battle-tested answer. In the "Marketing Department Replacement" scenario, users only need to input a simple prompt, and a "Marketing Director Agent" automatically goes online, instantly breaking down tasks and assembling a team. Sub-agents such as visual designers, marketing managers, content managers, and media specialists each perform their roles, with real-time synchronization of expertise and workflow progress, achieving more seamless coordination than human teams. This means that in the future, a single employee could command an entire "virtual marketing department."

In the "HR Replacement" scenario, the multi-agent system demonstrates deep processing capabilities for unstructured demands. From job postings and resume screening to interview assistance, multiple AI agents work in tandem. AI can not only accurately capture the employer's hiring intent but also perform comprehensive profile matching across vast numbers of resumes.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 5 de enero de 2026, 01.AI lanzó oficialmente las Seis Principales Predicciones para los Agentes de IA Empresariales en China 2026 y presentó sus últimos avances en agentes múltiples a nivel empresarial: "Wanzhi 2.5 Agentes Múltiples Empresariales". Según un informe de IDC, el mercado de software empresarial, valorado en 650 mil millones de dólares, está a punto de ser transformado por los agentes de IA. Se prevé que para 2031, la penetración de agentes de IA en centros de atención al cliente, equipos de ventas y aplicaciones de marketing se acerque al 100%. Además, IDC estima que el tamaño del mercado de aplicaciones de agentes empresariales en China alcanzará de manera conservadora más de 27 mil millones de dólares para 2028. Mientras la industria en general aún explora los agentes empresariales.
